# Blue Spruce Concrete & Landscaping

> Concrete & Landscaping in St. George, UT. Paver patios, concrete, block walls and full backyard landscaping across St. George and Washington County. Hard-working crews, clear communication, and finished work you'll show off.

## Services
- Paver patios: Custom patios and walkways laid level, tight and built to last in the Utah heat.
- Concrete work: Driveways, pads, sidewalks and RV parking, poured clean and finished right.
- Block walls: Privacy and retaining walls that look sharp and stay straight.
- Backyard landscaping: Complete backyard makeovers, from bare dirt to the yard you actually want to use.
